'''John David McAfee''' (September 18, 1945 – June 23, 2021) was a British-American businessman, computer programmer, and political activist known for founding the software company McAfee, Inc. Beyond his achievements in cybersecurity, McAfee's life was fraught with controversy, conspiracy theories, and legal issues.

== Conspiracies and Controversies ==
John McAfee became embroiled in numerous controversies throughout his life. Known for his maverick personality, McAfee often voiced conspiratorial views, particularly on government surveillance and taxation. In 2012, McAfee garnered international attention during a highly publicized legal conflict in Belize, where he was sought for questioning in connection with the death of his neighbor. He fled the country, leading to widespread media coverage and speculation regarding his involvement.

McAfee frequently claimed he was the target of sophisticated conspiracies, alleging that various governments aimed to silence him due to his outspoken opinions on privacy and corruption. His statements often lacked concrete evidence, fueling skepticism and intrigue among both supporters and critics.

== Connection to Alex Jones ==
John McAfee appeared on ''The Alex Jones Show'' multiple times, where he discussed his views on government overreach and personal liberty. McAfee and Jones shared similar libertarian ideologies, particularly on issues related to privacy and freedom from governmental control, which often resonated with Jones's audience. Their conversations covered a range of topics from cybersecurity threats to allegations of corruption within government institutions, with McAfee frequently warning of dystopian futures if personal freedoms were not protected.

== Political Ambitions ==
In addition to his business ventures and media presence, McAfee ran for the Libertarian Party's nomination for President of the United States in 2016 and 2020. His campaigns focused on advocating for increased cybersecurity, privacy rights, and cryptocurrency adoption. Despite not securing the nomination, his political endeavors added to his complex and often polarizing public persona.

== Legal Issues and Death ==
McAfee faced numerous legal challenges, including tax evasion charges in the United States. In 2020, he was arrested in Spain at the request of the US government, which sought his extradition. On June 23, 2021, McAfee was found dead in his prison cell in Spain in an apparent suicide, hours after the Spanish National Court authorized his extradition. His death prompted further conspiracy theories about foul play, reflecting his life-long entanglement with intrigue and speculation.
